title.en: Using the Output Embedding to Improve Language Models
title.zh-CN: 输入输出权重共享：早期实验

utility.en: Press and Wolf analyze shared input/output embeddings and report experiments in neural language modeling and machine translation.
utility.zh-CN: Press 与 Wolf 分析输入输出嵌入的权重共享，并报告神经语言模型和机器翻译实验。

notes.en: Experiments cover recurrent language models and neural machine translation.
notes.zh-CN: 实验涵盖循环神经语言模型与神经机器翻译。

title.en: By Tying Embeddings You Are Assuming the Distributional Hypothesis

utility.en: Connects weight tying to the distributional hypothesis and studies when input and output representations support a shared matrix.
utility.zh-CN: 将权重共享与分布假说联系起来，研究输入和输出表示在什么条件下适合共用矩阵。

notes.en: The argument for tying depends on the relationship between semantic similarity and contextual similarity in the data.
notes.zh-CN: 共享权重的论证取决于数据中语义相似性与上下文相似性的关系。

sources.author: Google
sources.version: English footer: 2025-11-01; Chinese page may differ

utility.en: Official documentation on PLE caching and accelerator-resident parameters, alongside selective loading of modality parameters in Gemma 3n.
utility.zh-CN: Gemma 3n 官方文档，介绍 PLE 缓存、加速器驻留参数，以及模态参数的选择性加载。

notes.en: PLE caching, MatFormer, and modality parameter skipping change different parts of the resource budget.
notes.zh-CN: PLE 缓存、MatFormer 与模态参数跳过分别改变资源预算的不同部分。

title.zh-CN: Gemma 4 嵌入与 block 源码

utility.en: Official embedding and decoder-block code, including token lookup, per-layer projections, gates, weight tying, and modality projections.
utility.zh-CN: 官方嵌入模块与解码器 block 源码，包含 token 查表、逐层投影、门控、权重共享和模态投影。

notes.en: The module defines table lookup, projection, gating, and modality input. Memory placement is a runtime concern.
notes.zh-CN: 模块定义查表、投影、门控与模态输入；存储位置由运行时安排。

title.en: SCONE: Scaling Embedding Layers in Language Models

utility.en: Extends input representations with frequent n-grams. A separate model produces contextual vectors that are precomputed for inference lookup.
utility.zh-CN: 用频繁 n-gram 扩展输入表示；独立模型生成上下文向量，推理时从预计算表读取。

notes.en: Training includes an f-gram learner. Inference uses precomputed vectors, with index storage and transfer costs.
notes.zh-CN: 训练包含 f-gram 学习器；推理使用预计算向量，仍需计入索引存储和传输。

utility.en: Architecture demo of n-gram hashing, multi-head lookup, and hidden-state-dependent gating, with simplified attention and MoE components.
utility.zh-CN: 架构演示代码，展示 n-gram 哈希、多头查表和依赖隐藏状态的门控；attention 与 MoE 使用简化占位实现。

notes.en: Architecture demo: attention, MoE, and hyper-connections are omitted or mocked.
notes.zh-CN: 架构演示省略或模拟了 attention、MoE 和超连接组件。

utility.en: Factorizes the vocabulary embedding matrix into a low-dimensional lookup table and a projection to the Transformer hidden width.
utility.zh-CN: 将词表嵌入矩阵分解为低维查表与隐藏维度投影，分开设置嵌入宽度和 Transformer 宽度。

notes.en: Encoder reference. A projection maps embedding width to hidden width when they differ.
notes.zh-CN: 编码器实现参照：嵌入维度与隐藏维度不同时，使用投影映射。

sources.author: Mingxue Xu; Yao Lei Xu; Danilo P. Mandic

utility.en: Compresses individual token vectors with Tensor Train factors and reconstructs a requested vector from its factors.
utility.zh-CN: 用张量列（Tensor Train）因子压缩各个 token 向量，并在查表时重构所需向量。

notes.en: Each token row is decomposed separately. Factor shapes, ranks, and reconstruction kernels determine its cost.
notes.zh-CN: 逐个分解 token 行；代价取决于因子形状、秩和重建内核。

title.en: OPTIC: compressed PLE with shared token codes
title.zh-CN: OPTIC：共享 token 编码的 PLE 压缩

sources.author: Jiacheng Liu et al.; VILA Lab

utility.en: Compresses PLE with compact token codes shared across layers and layer-specific affine decoders.
utility.zh-CN: 用跨层共享的紧凑 token 编码和每层仿射解码器压缩 PLE。

notes.en: Stores token-shared codes, codebooks, and per-layer decoders. Include all three in compressed storage.
notes.zh-CN: 保存跨层共享的 token 编码、码本与每层解码器；压缩存储需计入三者。

utility.en: An input-embedding quantization recipe using symmetric INT4 weights and group size 64, with reported Pythia-1.4B evaluations.
utility.zh-CN: 输入嵌入量化配方，采用对称 INT4 权重和 64 的组大小，附 Pythia-1.4B 评测结果。

notes.en: The example uses weight-only INT4 with group size 64. Storage includes packed values and quantization scales.
notes.zh-CN: 示例为仅权重 INT4 量化，组大小 64；存储包含打包值与量化缩放因子。

sources.author: Sebastian Raschka
sources.version: Live page; no immutable revision exposed

utility.en: Raschka explains the PLE residual path and discusses baselines needed to separate architectural effects from added parameter capacity.
utility.zh-CN: Raschka 解释 PLE 的残差路径，并讨论如何用对照实验区分结构作用与新增参数容量的作用。

notes.en: Explains the residual path and proposes controlled baselines for isolating the contribution of PLE.
notes.zh-CN: 解释残差路径，并提出用于区分 PLE 贡献的受控基线。

title.zh-CN: 从零实现语言模型：GPT 代码

utility.en: A compact GPT implementation accompanying the book, with token and position embeddings, Transformer blocks, and an output head.
utility.zh-CN: 《从零构建大语言模型》配套的简洁 GPT 实现，包含 token 与位置嵌入、Transformer block 和输出头。

notes.en: Chapter 4 shows the token lookup, Transformer stack, and output head in a compact GPT implementation.
notes.zh-CN: 第 4 章用紧凑的 GPT 实现展示 token 查表、Transformer 主干与输出头。

utility.en: A systems tutorial on accessed rows, prefetching, caching, and simulated offloading for n-gram memory.
utility.zh-CN: 围绕 n-gram 记忆的系统教程，介绍访问行、预取、缓存与卸载模拟。

notes.en: The systems lab includes exercises, reference solutions, and offload simulations. Check the assumptions before using its estimates.
notes.zh-CN: 系统课包含练习、参考解答和卸载模拟；使用估算时需查看假设。

title.zh-CN: SigLIP 2 图像块投影与位置嵌入

utility.en: Implementation of image-patch projections and learned position embeddings in the SigLIP 2 vision encoder.
utility.zh-CN: SigLIP 2 视觉编码器中的图像块投影与可学习位置嵌入实现。

notes.en: Continuous patch projection and discrete positional lookup are separate operations.
notes.zh-CN: 连续图像块投影与离散位置查表是不同操作。

title.en: Mimi codec and Moshi token embeddings
title.zh-CN: Mimi codec 与 Moshi token 嵌入

utility.en: Mimi audio codec and Moshi language-model code, showing codec codebooks alongside separate audio token embedding tables.
utility.zh-CN: Mimi 音频 codec 与 Moshi 语言模型实现，可对照 codec 码本和独立的音频 token 嵌入表。

notes.en: Codec EMA state and downstream token tables have separate storage and training roles.
notes.zh-CN: codec 的 EMA 状态与下游 token 表承担不同的存储与训练职责。

utility.en: Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ) implementation with fixed scalar levels, optional learned projections, and a materialized codebook buffer.
utility.zh-CN: 有限标量量化（FSQ）实现，包含固定标量级别、可选的可学习投影和物化码本缓冲区。

notes.en: Archived implementation of fixed scalar levels, optional learned projections, and a non-persistent codebook buffer.
notes.zh-CN: 归档实现采用固定标量级别，可选学习投影，并分配非持久码本缓冲区。

sources.author: Alexei Baevski; Michael Auli; fairseq contributors

utility.en: Assigns different embedding widths to vocabulary groups by frequency, then projects them to a common model width.
utility.zh-CN: 按词频为不同词表组分配不同嵌入维度，再投影到统一的模型宽度。

observations.locator: Sections 1–3, frequency bands and weight sharing

notes.en: Frequency bands have different widths. Adaptive input/output tying requires matching cutoffs, factors, and dimensions.
notes.zh-CN: 不同词频分组使用不同维度；自适应输入输出共享要求分界、因子与维度匹配。

title.en: Andrej Karpathy: tokenization and embedding lookup

utility.en: Karpathy’s BPE tokenizer implementation and lecture materials connect text, token IDs, vocabulary size, and embedding-table rows.
utility.zh-CN: Karpathy 的 BPE 分词器实现与讲义，串联文本、token ID、词表大小和嵌入表行。

observations.locator: Character-level tokenization; trainable table rows; BPE introduction

notes.en: The written lecture is partial. It covers the tokenizer-to-table boundary; the linked video and repository continue the BPE lesson.
notes.zh-CN: 文字讲义尚未完稿，已覆盖分词器与嵌入表的衔接；后续 BPE 内容可沿视频与仓库学习。

utility.en: The model team introduces the on-device motivation for PLE and explains total versus accelerator-resident parameters in Gemma 3n.
utility.zh-CN: 模型团队介绍 PLE 的端侧部署动机，以及 Gemma 3n 总参数量与加速器驻留参数量的区别。

observations.locator: Per-Layer Embeddings (PLE): Unlocking more memory efficiency

notes.en: An introductory companion to the technical documentation. The PLE section explains CPU placement in the on-device model design.
notes.zh-CN: 作为技术文档的入门补充；PLE 一节解释了端侧模型设计中的 CPU 存储与计算安排。

title.en: LongCat: Scaling Embeddings Outperforms Scaling Experts
title.zh-CN: LongCat：嵌入容量与专家容量的扩展比较

utility.en: Compares embedding and MoE capacity allocation and describes the LongCat-Flash-Lite system design.
utility.zh-CN: 比较嵌入与 MoE 专家的容量分配，并介绍 LongCat-Flash-Lite 的系统设计。

observations.locator: Architecture, embedding/expert allocation experiments, and systems optimizations

notes.en: The claimed advantage holds in the paper’s studied regimes. Read its parameter budgets, model widths, and systems optimizations together.
notes.zh-CN: 论文报告的优势对应其所研究的设置；应结合参数预算、模型宽度与系统优化阅读。

title.en: Qwen3.8-Next: n-gram placement and vocabulary ablations
title.zh-CN: Qwen3.8-Next：n-gram 注入位置与词表消融

utility.en: Reports ablations of n-gram injection sites and vocabulary budgets, alongside a host-memory prefetch design.
utility.zh-CN: 报告 n-gram 注入位置与词表预算的消融实验，并介绍主机内存预取设计。

observations.locator: Section 2.3; Tables 7–9; host prefetch at Layer 2

notes.en: Section 2.3 compares injection sites and vocabulary budgets. In its added-capacity experiments, loss falls while some downstream scores saturate or fluctuate.
notes.zh-CN: 第 2.3 节比较注入位置与词表预算；在增加容量的实验中，损失下降，但部分下游指标趋于饱和或波动。

title.en: STAPLE: embedding memory for pretrained checkpoints
title.zh-CN: STAPLE：为预训练检查点加入嵌入记忆

utility.en: Adds token-lookup residual memory to pretrained checkpoints, with warm-up and host-offloading designs.
utility.zh-CN: 为预训练检查点加入 token 查表残差记忆，并提供预热和主机卸载设计。

notes.en: Retains the pretrained FFN up-projection and adds a token-indexed residual path. The paper specifies cache and serving conditions; the README gives an eight-GPU training workflow.
notes.zh-CN: 保留预训练 FFN 上投影，加入按 token ID 查表的残差路径。论文列出缓存与推理设置；README 给出八 GPU 训练流程。

title.en: COUNT: n-gram embeddings from corpus counts
title.zh-CN: COUNT：用语料统计构造 n-gram 嵌入

sources.author: Ian Magnusson; Noah A. Smith; Pang Wei Koh

utility.en: Constructs n-gram embeddings from fixed corpus statistics and existing output vectors, providing an alternative to learned table rows.
utility.zh-CN: 用固定语料统计和模型已有输出向量构造 n-gram 嵌入，为学习表行提供另一种方案。

notes.en: COUNT stores counts on the host and combines existing output embeddings. The paper also studies swapping domain-specific count tables at inference.
notes.zh-CN: COUNT 在主机端保存统计，组合模型已有的输出嵌入；论文还研究了推理时切换领域统计表。

sources.author: Vincent-Pierre Berges; Barlas Oğuz et al.

utility.en: A comparison with token-ID and n-gram lookup: trainable product-key memory queried by hidden states.
utility.zh-CN: 作为 token ID 与 n-gram 查表的对照，介绍由隐藏状态查询的可训练乘积键记忆。

notes.en: A neighboring mechanism: queries depend on hidden states. The paper and reference implementation discuss sparse lookup, memory bandwidth, and distributed value tables.
notes.zh-CN: 作为相邻机制对照：查询依赖隐状态。论文与参考实现讨论了稀疏查表、内存带宽和分布式值表。

title.zh-CN: GroupReduce：按词频分组的低秩压缩

sources.author: Patrick H. Chen; Si Si; Yang Li; Ciprian Chelba; Cho-Jui Hsieh

utility.en: Compresses vocabulary blocks with frequency-aware weighted low-rank approximation.
utility.zh-CN: 按词频对词表分块，使用加权低秩近似压缩各块。

notes.en: Groups vocabulary items by frequency, then refines weighted low-rank blocks. Experiments use historical neural language and translation models.
notes.zh-CN: 先按词频对词表分组，再迭代优化各块的加权低秩近似；实验使用当时的神经语言模型和翻译模型。

sources.author: Oleksii Hrinchuk; Valentin Khrulkov; Leyla Mirvakhabova; Elena Orlova; Ivan Oseledets
sources.version: Findings of EMNLP 2020, pp. 4847–4860; earlier preprint arXiv:1901.10787

utility.en: Parameterizes an entire embedding table with shared Tensor Train factors and studies end-to-end training.
utility.zh-CN: 用共享张量列因子参数化整张嵌入表，并研究端到端训练。

observations.version: Findings of EMNLP 2020, pp. 4847–4860; earlier preprint arXiv:1901.10787

notes.en: Represents vocabulary and feature axes using shared TT factors and reconstructs requested rows. The paper studies training these compact layers end to end.
notes.zh-CN: 用共享 TT 因子表示词表轴与特征轴，并重构所请求的表行；论文研究了紧凑嵌入层的端到端训练。

utility.en: Vocabulary-parallel lookup code: row sharding, token-ID masking, local lookup, and collective communication across devices.
utility.zh-CN: 词表并行查表实现，包含行分片、token ID 掩码、本地查表和跨设备集合通信。

notes.en: Shards the table across vocabulary rows. The forward path masks non-local IDs and combines results; sharding and compression solve different storage problems.
notes.zh-CN: 沿词表行对嵌入表分片；前向路径屏蔽非本地 ID 并合并结果。分片与压缩解决的存储问题不同。

title.en: Weight Tying Biases Token Embeddings Towards the Output Space
title.zh-CN: 权重共享如何使 token 嵌入偏向输出空间

sources.author: Antonio Lopardo; Avyukth Harish; Catherine Arnett; Akshat Gupta

utility.en: Studies input/output gradient imbalance in tied embeddings and interventions that change their alignment with the output space.
utility.zh-CN: 研究共享嵌入中的输入输出梯度不平衡，以及改变其输出空间对齐程度的干预。

notes.en: The authors rescale input gradients and change embedding alignment, without consistent downstream gains. Some tied/untied model comparisons also differ in training data.
notes.zh-CN: 作者重调输入梯度后，嵌入对齐发生变化，下游表现却没有一致提升。部分共享与非共享模型对照也存在训练数据差异。

statement.en: A tied ordinary token table supplies input lookup and output projection.
statement.zh-CN: 共享的普通 token 表同时供输入查表与输出投影使用。

limits.en: This does not tie the separate PLE table or eliminate output projection.
limits.zh-CN: 这不意味着共享独立 PLE 表，也不消除输出投影。

statement.en: Gemma 4 prepares a token lookup plus model projection, then uses a hidden-state-gated per-layer residual update.
statement.zh-CN: Gemma 4 先准备 token 查表与模型投影，再在每层以隐藏状态门控加入残差更新。

limits.en: No runtime offload or universal quality benefit follows from this code alone.
limits.zh-CN: 仅凭此源码不能推导运行时卸载或普遍质量收益。

statement.en: SCONE extends contextual input embeddings; Engram demo fuses hashed n-gram memory at selected internal layers.
statement.zh-CN: SCONE 扩展上下文输入嵌入；Engram 演示在选定内部层融合哈希 n-gram 记忆。

limits.en: Shared vocabulary does not establish tested composition.
limits.zh-CN: 共用术语不能证明组合已被测试。

statement.en: Compression acts on distinct table objects and adds method-specific metadata or reconstruction.
statement.zh-CN: 压缩作用于不同表对象，额外元数据或重建依方法而异。

limits.en: Compression ratios cannot establish equal runtime or quality.
limits.zh-CN: 压缩率不能证明运行代价或质量相等。

statement.en: Continuous patch and modality projections differ from discrete ID lookup.
statement.zh-CN: 连续图像块及模态投影不同于离散 ID 查表。

limits.en: Position embeddings can still use a separate lookup table.
limits.zh-CN: 位置嵌入仍可使用独立查表。

statement.en: Codec codebooks and downstream LM token tables have distinct computational roles.
statement.zh-CN: codec 码本与下游 LM token 表的计算职责不同。

limits.en: Fixed or EMA-updated codebooks are not necessarily trainable parameter tables.
limits.zh-CN: 固定或 EMA 更新的码本不一定是可训练参数表。

statement.en: Adaptive input uses variable-width vocabulary bands with projections; fairseq checks matching factors, cutoffs and dimensions when tying adaptive weights.
statement.zh-CN: 自适应输入使用不同维度的词表分组与投影；fairseq 共享自适应权重时检查因子、分界与维度匹配。

limits.en: Historical implementation inspected, not trained or benchmarked here; a configuration check does not establish every possible pairing.
limits.zh-CN: 已检查历史实现，未在本地训练或测试性能；配置检查不能证明任意组合都成立。

title.zh-CN: 音频码本与语言模型嵌入

title.en: PLE: table capacity and compute cost
title.zh-CN: PLE 的容量与计算代价

title.en: Weight tying: storage savings and representation constraints
title.zh-CN: 权重共享：存储收益与表示约束

object.en: E ∈ R^(V×d); same E may supply logits

injection.en: Before blocks; tied Eᵀ at output

storage.zh-CN: 共享时 Vd 个独立值；b 位时 Vdb/8 Bytes，不含其他项

accelerator.en: Placement dependent; tied head may require broad access to E
accelerator.zh-CN: 依赖放置方式；共享输出头可能需要广泛访问 E

access.zh-CN: 输入只读取所选行；通常全词表 logits 使用全部行

flops.en: Lookup is memory access; full output projection scales with Vd per hidden vector
flops.zh-CN: 查表主要为内存访问；全输出投影每个隐藏向量按 Vd 扩展

latency.en: Unknown for a matched runtime and hardware setup.
latency.zh-CN: 缺少相同运行环境与硬件下的测量。

injection.zh-CN: block 外准备；启用的 block 在 attention＋FFN 后加入门控更新

storage.zh-CN: 表：VLdₚ 个值；VLdₚb/8 Bytes；未计投影

accelerator.en: Table placement and materialized layer inputs matter; source alone does not prove offload
accelerator.zh-CN: 取决于表放置和层输入的物化；该源码本身不能证明卸载

access.en: Token-addressed rows are predictable; projections and gates still run
access.zh-CN: token 寻址可预知；仍需执行投影与门控

flops.en: Extra model projection and per-layer gate/projection; not zero FLOPs
flops.zh-CN: 增加模型投影和每层门控／投影；FLOPs 不为零

latency.en: Unknown for a matched runtime and hardware setup.
latency.zh-CN: 缺少相同运行环境与硬件下的测量。

key.zh-CN: 高频上下文 n-gram 匹配

object.en: Input contextual vectors; output vocabulary unchanged
object.zh-CN: 上下文输入向量；输出词表不变

injection.zh-CN: 主干前的输入嵌入扩展

training.en: Train separate f-gram learner, then precompute vectors
training.zh-CN: 训练独立 f-gram 学习器，再预计算向量

storage.en: Cached vector count × width × precision, plus index; training learner separate
storage.zh-CN: 缓存向量数×维度×精度，另有索引；训练学习器另计

accelerator.en: Off-accelerator cache in paper; fixed inference accelerator resources under its setup
accelerator.zh-CN: 论文将缓存置于加速器外；固定推理资源结论有实验条件

access.en: Match/query/transfer; cache and bandwidth constrain implementation
access.zh-CN: 需要匹配、查询和传输；依赖缓存与带宽

flops.en: Learner moved out of inference; training/precompute still cost compute
flops.zh-CN: 学习器不在推理路径；训练和预计算仍有计算代价

latency.en: Author-reported query results; no universal end-to-end bound
latency.zh-CN: 作者报告了查询结果；没有通用端到端延迟上界

key.zh-CN: 规范化 n-gram 的多头哈希

object.en: Hashed tables plus key/value projections and convolution
object.zh-CN: 哈希表、键值投影和卷积

injection.en: Selected internal blocks, before attention in demo
